name: WhatsMyName
description: OSINT username enumeration across ~700 sites using the WhatsMyName dataset, checked directly from the Vineyard desktop app. Runs the whole selection, one handle at a time. Desktop only: a browser cannot read the cross-origin responses these checks depend on.

plugins.name: WhatsMyName Account Search
plugins.description: Checks whether each selected username (or the local part of an email address) exists across ~700 sites (WhatsMyName dataset) by querying each site directly from the Vineyard desktop app. Adds a Handle node for each name and one Account per website it was found on, linked to it. A site that looks like a hit is independently re-checked before being added: a body-signature scan for antibot/challenge interstitials, and — if that's clean — a differential probe with a definitely-nonexistent account of matching shape, so a generic error page, a search-page fallback, or an unrecognised antibot wall can't produce a false account. Sites that fail this check are counted as blocked, not silently added. Runs the selection one node at a time — the per-node sweep already uses this app's full request concurrency, so nodes queue rather than compete. Desktop only — a browser cannot read the cross-origin responses these checks depend on.

network.purpose: Fetch the latest WhatsMyName site list (CDN, CORS-enabled).

web_probe.purpose: Request each WhatsMyName site directly to see whether the handle resolves to a profile. Desktop only; the request is anonymous (no cookies), never follows redirects, and cannot reach private or loopback addresses.
